name: Choate Summer Programs
description_short: Academic summer programs at Choate Rosemary Hall in Wallingford, for boarding or day students, in 2, 4 and 5 week sessions. Middle and high school students take enrichment courses and signature programs such as the Theater Arts Institute and the JFK Institute in Government, with afternoon activities and weekend trips; a day Young Artist Program serves younger children.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer programs page: 2027 dates June 26 to July 30 with 2, 4 and 5 week programs; programs for students who have completed grades 6 to 12, plus the Young Artist Program for elementary and middle school students. Address and zip in the page footer; phone and email are the Summer Programs Office.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2027 Program Fees. Middle school and high school programs are for students entering grades 7 to 12; Young Artist Program for students entering grades 1 to 6 (day only, $1,200 for 2 weeks). Prices run from $1,200 (Young Artist, day) to $12,820 (5 week English Language Institute or JFK Institute, boarding). Boarding includes room and board; day tuition includes class day meals. Minimum boarding age is 11.
